description: Offline binding map for MIA humanoid fp16 — ComfyUI API form of integrations/vendor/ComfyUI-UniRig/mia_humanoid.json. No GPU execution; template+verify only.

INPUT_MESH.comment: Vendor workflow uses Combo widgets [source_folder='input', file_path='3d/realistic_male_character.glb'] with no link. API binding injects the preserved Hunyuan-painted GLB path here. Tooling must probe object_info() to resolve which key the installed UniRig version actually exposes (vendor has used both file_path and path).
INPUT_MESH.fallback_strategy: Probe UniRigLoadMesh input schema; inject into the one key that exists. If both absent, fail closed — do not guess filesystem conventions.

OUTPUT_DIR.comment: Preview node writes mixamo.fbx; API form resolves Save path via OUTPUT_DIR. When paired with comfyui_client.py _collect_direct_outputs, the FBX is harvested even if /history returns no file record (mini_turbo heritage).

output_file.comment: Single-file output contract for the downstream five_pose_proof.py (FBX input).

delta_from_vendor.precision: fp32 -> fp16 (explicit binding; MIALoadModel supports fp32/fp16/bf16; fp16 is the project's VRAM-5600 budget; keep weight path auditing in rig_backend_preflight.py MIA_WEIGHT_FILES)
delta_from_vendor.cache_to_gpu: false (prevents persistent VRAM residency between the MIA pass and the subsequent Blender proof in a shared 1660S 6GB session; mirrors atlas_detail_fill-style offload discipline)

api_injection.comment: Not all UniRig releases expose cache_to_gpu. Injection is conditional: if object_info()['MIALoadModel'].input.required has no cache_to_gpu key, the injector skips it and the low-VRAM posture is achieved by unloading the model (drop reference) immediately after the MIAAutoRig node completes. No custom attention patch here.

rig_node.comment: MIAAutoRig is NOT Save 3D Mesh — it outputs an FBX path string linked to UniRigPreviewRiggedMesh. The stock comfyui_client.py _shape_save_node guard (Save 3D Mesh only) does NOT apply; the MIA API workflow keeps the native FBX-through-preview topology. See comfyui reuse note below.

comfyui_client_reuse.verdict: PARTIALLY REUSABLE — adapter needed for MIA topology
detail: load_api_workflow(workflow_path, replacements) is reusable unchanged when the workflow is already in API format: it is just json.loads + _replace(copy.deepcopy) token substitution.

ui_to_api() is NOT directly reusable for MIA workflows on the current implementation: it hard-codes _shape_save_node() to search for 'Save 3D Mesh' and traces ancestors from that single node (_ancestor_ids). MIAAutoRig does not contain 'Save 3D Mesh'; the MIA graph's terminal is UniRigPreviewRiggedMesh[String] and its upstream MIAAutoRig, so _shape_save_node() raises 'UI workflow contains no Save 3D Mesh node'.

Reuse strategy (no rewrite of the existing Mini-Turbo path): add a small dispatcher — _shape_save_node_for_workflow(nodes): if any node.type contains 'MIAAutoRig' or 'UniRigPreviewRiggedMesh', target that node; else use existing Save 3D Mesh logic. Ancestor walk and widget-value -> inputs mapping are otherwise correct for MIA nodes (checked: MIALoadModel and MIAAutoRig schemas follow the same required/optional ordering convention).

_replace() INPUT_MESH / OUTPUT_DIR token scheme is correct for MIA at the String level, but UniRigLoadMesh's file_path Combo needs the String injected via the Mapped Combo handling in _replace (resolved by object_info probe above). A Template+Verify harness should assert that the round-tripped API prompt contains the injected INPUT_MESH basename before submitting to /prompt.

Output collection: MIA writes FBX, not GLB. _collect_direct_outputs already allows .fbx? It currently allows {.glb,.gltf,.obj,.ply,.stl,.png,.jpg,.jpeg,.webp,.json} — add .fbx to the allowed set for the MIA route, or add a dedicated MiaCollectOutput step. Otherwise the MIA FBX will be classified as missing and the harness will exhaust retries.

_collect_files() / /view history path still applies, but UniRig's preview nodes almost always rely on direct file write, so the 10x polling fallback in run_api_workflow is the primary success path for MIA (same as Mini Turbo).

flow: resolve_mia_api_template(workflow_path=mia_humanoid.json, input_mesh=INPUT_MESH, output_dir=OUTPUT_DIR, precision=fp16) -> api_prompt dict (no network)

verify_api_prompt(api_prompt): assert node 41 precision == 'fp16' and node 27 file_path endswith INPUT_MESH basename and no Save 3D Mesh node is assumed; also assert that only ancestors of Mia target nodes are kept (no spurious graph retention)
on GPU stage: ComfyUIClient(base_url).run_api_workflow on the verified prompt; gate on peak_vram_mb <= 5600; harvest ${OUTPUT_DIR}/mia_rigged.fbx via direct-output polling
pipe FBX into blender/five_pose_proof.py --input mia_rigged.fbx --output-dir proof/rig/mia_<asset>_five_pose --report proof/rig/mia_<asset>_five_pose/report.json
offline_artifacts_produced_here: blender/five_pose_proof.py (spec + scaffold implementation — py_compile clean without Blender)
not_done_here: No ComfyUI /history poll, no /prompt submission, no model .pth download, no CUDA import.
No Blender render execution (that requires a display-capable Blender and a rigged asset; the scaffold is invocable as blender --background --python blender/five_pose_proof.py -- --input ...).

depth: thorough — every deferred GPU decision is recorded with file:line and fallback, not silently assumed.
